quotes.text: The D209916 reviewer asked for margin-inline:4px 0 on the address container and later requested a first-child rule for the first pill instead of changing every pill’s end margin. The accepted CSS keeps .address-pill margin-inline-end:3px and adds &:first-child { margin-inline-start:4px; }. It uses logical inline/block properties in shared and platform stylesheets. The patch author said only Linux had been tested during review, so the accepted layout is not evidence of a cross-platform visual test. The current checkout retains these spacing rules.
